content.headline: Lagos-made technical clothing, in runs of 180
content.subheadline: Shot in-house, made in runs of 300. When it is gone, it is gone.

content.heading: NOVA drops in
content.note: Friday 9 October, 19:00 local time

content.heading: The drop
content.sub: Made in runs of 300. Restocks are announced to the waitlist first.

products.name: Drop 01 — Shell Jacket
products.blurb: Water-repelled cotton twill, taped seams, cut long.

products.name: Drop 01 — Cargo Trouser
products.blurb: Two-way zip cargo, ripstop, six pockets.

products.name: Drop 01 — Heavy Tee
products.blurb: 240gsm organic jersey, boxy through the shoulder, made in Ibadan.

content.note: Prices include duties for local orders.

content.heading: What that looks like in practice
content.sub: Built with people who care about cut, fabric and where a garment was made, not for a theoretical someone.

items.title: Materials first
items.body: Waxed canvas sourced from people we can name. It ages well and it repairs cheaply.

items.title: Made in small runs
items.body: Every drop is capped at 300 units, so nothing gets discounted to death.

items.title: Ships worldwide
items.body: Tracked, duties handled, returns accepted for 7 days without a conversation.

items.title: Built to be seen
items.body: Cut for people who care about cut, fabric and where a garment was made who notice stitching, weight and the way light hits a surface.

content.heading: Shot on the phone, in the room

items.quote: They answered my 11pm message. I do not know how, but they did.
items.name: Daniel B.

items.quote: The countdown page made our whole team commit to the date. Scary, effective.
items.name: Ife K.

items.quote: I have never had to explain NOVA to a colleague twice. It is that obvious to use.
items.name: Tomi A.

content.heading: Pricing, up front
content.sub: No demo call required. Everything includes tax.

plans.name: Starter
plans.blurb: For one person with one problem to fix.

plans.name: Pro
plans.blurb: The plan people who care about cut, fabric and where a garment was made actually pick.

content.note: Payment on delivery, receipts by email.

content.heading: Get on the NOVA list
content.body: Two emails, maximum: one when the streetwear opens, one when it closes. Positions go out in order.
content.privacy: We never pass your address on. One click to leave.
content.successCopy: You are on the list. We will email Friday 9 October.

content.heading: Do not read about it later
content.body: The waitlist is how you get the first run. Everything after that is resale.
content.note: Reply within 1 hours, usually sooner.

content.heading: How it came about
paragraphs: Afterglow started making lives in Lagos with a borrowed interface and a microphone held to a door. add the backstage photo to the artist story, not the gallery.
The record was cut over 13 weeks with the doors shut. No grid, no correction — what you hear is the room and the takes that worked.
It is out Wednesday 14 October. The film follows the same day, in one take.
content.quote: If it sounds a little dangerous, that is because it was.

content.headline: Book Wilson Yam, forget the worry
content.subheadline: Transparent pricing, real people, and a phone that gets answered.

content.heading: Why Wilson Yam exists
content.body: We are Wilson Yam. We make service for locals who want it done once, properly who would rather have one good option than twelve mediocre ones. Everything here is written by the people who build it, which is why it reads like a person and not a brochure.
bullets: Made for locals who want it done once, properly
The job gets done once — that is the whole brief

content.heading: How Wilson Yam works
content.sub: Built with locals who want it done once, properly, not for a theoretical someone.

items.title: Documented work
items.body: Photos, notes and a signed job sheet for every visit. Useful when something goes wrong later.

items.title: Local and accountable
items.body: Based in Accra, working within 30km, and our reputation depends on you telling friends.

items.title: Fixed, transparent pricing
items.body: You get the number before we start. Nothing appears on the invoice that was not quoted.

items.title: Real people, fast
items.body: Call +234 8030864 981 and a human picks up. Average reply time is 2 hours.

content.heading: Wilson Yam, out loud
content.sub: Small on purpose. You deal with the people who make the thing.

items.name: Ada Okonkwo
items.bio: Started this in a spare room and never moved out.

items.name: Bisi Adeniran
items.bio: Ships the boring parts properly, which is most of them.

items.name: Kwame Mensah
items.bio: Keeps the calendar, the suppliers and your sanity.

items.quote: They answered my 11pm message. I do not know how, but they did.
items.name: Daniel B.

items.quote: We switched from a tool three times the price and nothing got worse. Half the complaints stopped.
items.name: Grace E.
items.role: Head of product at a 40-person team

items.quote: It arrived when they said it would, and it works the way they described it. That is the whole review.
items.name: Amaka O.
items.role: Founder, first order on day one

content.heading: Pricing, up front
content.sub: No demo call required. Everything includes tax.

plans.name: Starter
plans.blurb: For one person with one problem to fix.

plans.name: Pro
plans.blurb: The plan locals who want it done once, properly actually pick.

content.note: Payment on delivery, receipts by email.

content.heading: Talk to a person
content.body: Call, or send the details and we will quote it back the same day.
content.note: We reply inside a day. If it is urgent, call.

content.heading: The drop
content.sub: Everything below is real, available and priced without a sales call.

products.blurb: Water-repelled cotton twill, taped seams, cut long.

products.blurb: Two-way zip cargo, ripstop, six pockets.

products.name: Drop 01 — Heavy Tee
products.blurb: 240gsm organic jersey, boxy through the shoulder, made in Accra.

content.note: Prices include duties for local orders.
